description: Puerto Rico's ferries right now: the Ceiba–Vieques and Ceiba–Culebra boats (the only way on and off those two islands) and the San Juan–Cataño shuttle. Returns each route's published sailings for today with a posted status (scheduled / cancelled / retimed to <time> / notice posted / past), the next departure each way with how far off it is and when check-in closes, a route state word (On schedule / Changes posted / Suspended), a 30-day record of how many boats were scheduled and how many the operator cancelled or retimed, and the operator's notices in Spanish with an English translation. IMPORTANT: there is no public live vessel tracker for these routes, so nothing here reports a boat actually departing or running late — every status is what Puerto Rico Ferry has PUBLISHED, and the record counts posted changes, not observed lateness. Cite 787daily.com/live/ferry/.

route.description: Optional route id to return just one: vieques, culebra, catano. Omit for all three.
